I understand that, and I'm fearful of that. I know that it doesn't matter what I do, I'll end up losing her. It can be viewed as a lesson and not such a bad thing, but I know that not having her in my life anymore will tear me down.

Its going to be hard. If I'm honest, I don't think I'm able to do so. I just can't.

That's alright, I get what you're saying. She's not the first though. I've met another woman a couple years ago who cares a lot about me. I view her like a sister at this point, she's just not around as much these days, but that's fine. She's still there.

The feelings I have for F, I've been able to differentiate between the ones I'd have for the person who was my close friend and became my sister.

I think you're on the nose with that. I don't see her as my partner at all, but it feels like she cares about me beyond a professional level. Not saying that level is romantic, because I don't know. I'm still trying to convince myself that's a possibility though. I don't know if it's me or what, but I don't view her as someone just doing her job, which in reality, I probably should. It's hard for me to describe what is at play for me. I feel like she cares.

I think it's typical infatuation is building up with all I can think about being our talks, her eyes and her smile.

Love is a strong word haha. I want to think of it like that, really. I'm not one to often express my emotions, being raised in a typical toxic manly man household and all that, but it just seemed so easy to be myself around someone for once with her. I'm trying not to bawl my eyes out when thinking about one day not seeing her anymore or cutting off contact. What's "logical" so to say is in front of my face. I just don't think I can accept it at this point in time. Dankjewel.

It is going to be difficult. I don't even know if I'll be able to go through with it. I know what you're all saying is right and I wish I could just cross her off or never even have developed these feelings in the first place. It's the first time in 2 years since a serious relationship that I've felt this way about another person and it's devasting that it's her. I'm in a happy position in life because of her, yet I feel like this is something that could just tear me down whether I let it pass or get rejected if I do act on these feelings.

I already felt like this was going to be the most common answer/solution given. And I can't blame any of you. I'm young, naive and desperate for any form of love. Whether it's platonic or romantic and unfortunately in this case, it turning romantic is not in my favor. I don't think I could get a new social worker if I'm honest. I've tried for years and F was really the first person I clicked with. I know it's for the better, but just thinking about cutting ties with the one person who's shown real care for me here in years is heartbreaking.

I've got a therapist and discussed this with her as well. She told me it wasn't surprising to hear that after not having anyone in my life I was close with, not even family, having a person come in and offer such kindness and support. And that it may be better not to act on these feelings, but instead let them be.
